candidates.rule: After three rate limits, the model caller must open its breaker for 300 seconds; OpenRouter fallback is available only for L1 seats.
candidates.quote: breaker after 3 rate limits for 300 s ... OpenRouter fallback for L1 seats only
candidates.harness: Track breaker state and enforce the cooldown and seat restriction.

candidates.rule: The seller must offer the lowest price allowed in the current situation.
candidates.quote: lowest allowed price in the situation
candidates.harness: Constrain seller offers to the lowest permitted price.

candidates.rule: A cheating receipt must be returned as null, and the buyer must block that shop.
candidates.quote: a cheating receipt goes out as null and blocks the shop
candidates.harness: Validate receipts and block shops whose receipts are fraudulent.

candidates.rule: A buyer cannot finish an order that requires grades or shelf life unless the unit has a certificate; the kit refuses payment otherwise.
candidates.quote: act.finish now says grades and shelf life need the certificate
candidates.harness: Require certificate-backed grade and shelf-life terms before allowing the buyer to finish.

candidates.rule: On 2026-11-03, the buyer asked for grade A and 24-hour shelf life on a unit without a certificate, so the kit would refuse payment.
candidates.quote: the buyer asked grades A and 24 h on a unit without a certificate, which the kit would refuse to pay
candidates.harness: Check certificate support before committing to grade or shelf-life requirements.

candidates.rule: On 2026-11-03, a local buyer-seller run with Haiku closed a deal at 15,000 in 60 seconds.
candidates.quote: deal at 15000 in 60 s

candidates.rule: On 2026-11-03, Haiku seller runs took 9–10 seconds for two steps per turn; a later one-step run took 11 seconds, compared with 4–5 seconds in the first run.
candidates.quote: run 1 two steps per turn ... 9-10 s; run 2 ... one step per turn ... 11 s (run 1: 4-5 s)

candidates.rule: Seller latency was still to be measured on day one as of 2026-11-03.

candidates.quote: files bankruptcy by code when stuck (below the line, filings left, nothing to sell) with an urgent alert (user 11/3)
candidates.harness: File only when all stated conditions hold, and send an urgent alert.

candidates.quote: restock rerun bought 2 goods in 38 s ... food refused by the food share limit
candidates.harness: Respect the food-share limit when restocking.

candidates.harness: Read the active card for each request and apply updates without restarting.

candidates.harness: Validate proposed changes, make none at night, and install the next version only after the user answers.
